{{Quote|Major, have your squadron make a run on the assault carriers coming down.''"<br />"''I copy.''"<br />"''Alpha Squadron and I will deal with the fighters.|Soontir Fel and [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], during the Battle of Brentaal IV|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 22]]</ref>}}
'''Alpha Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the three-squadron strong [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]]. While the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|battled]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] led Alpha Squadron in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oradin]]. He then took the squadron to defend the city of [[Vuultin]] at the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lon Isoto]].
